data.name: Burayrah
data.gender_notes: Burayrah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'B-R-Y', meaning 'garden' or 'owner of a garden'. In Islamic tradition, Burayrah is a name for boys. The name Burayrah carries the meaning “The owner of a garden” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Burayrah usually hope their child will grow to embody the owner of a garden and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Burayrah is a name that symbolizes strength, stability, and connection to the earth. It is believed to bring blessings of prosperity, abundance, and a deep sense of joy.
data.etymology: Burayrah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The owner of a garden.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Burayrah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: بوريرة

in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم بوريرة هو اسم مشتق من البريّة، ويشير إلى الأرض أو الحصينة، وقد ورد ذكره في الحديث النبوي، ويعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة وطيبة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: بُرَیرہ

in_hindi.name: बुरैरा
in_hindi.meaning: बुरैरा का अर्थ है भूमि या सुरक्षित स्थान

in_english.name: Burayrah
in_english.meaning: Means land or secure place in Arabic

In many Islamic communities, children are named based on the blessings and prophecies from the Quran and Hadiths, and Burayrah can be seen as a reflection of these qualities.

Burayrah, as a name meaning 'owner of a garden', can be seen as a reminder of the spiritual significance and promise of paradise, which is a reward for those who lead a virtuous life and follow the teachings of Islam. The name also reflects the idea of being a caretaker and nurturer of this earthly and otherworldly garden, cultivating goodness, kindness, and righteousness in all aspects of life.
